figs.name: measurement-uncertainty-in-calibration-type-a-type-b-diagram
figs.alt: measurement uncertainty in calibration Type A and Type B components combined by root sum of squares
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing Type A repeatability and five Type B components, each turned into a standard uncertainty, combined by root sum of squares and expanded with k.
figs.after_h2: Type A and Type B Uncertainty: The Fundamental Division
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Type A and Type B uncertainty components combined into uc and expanded uncertainty U</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Where Calibration Uncertainty Comes From</text>
<rect x="20" y="58" width="250" height="300" rx="14" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="145" y="90" font-size="22" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type A</text>
<text x="145" y="116" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">statistics of</text>
<text x="145" y="138" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">repeated readings</text>
<rect x="40" y="160" width="210" height="86" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145.0" y="185.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ua</text>
<text x="145.0" y="208.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">repeatability</text>
<text x="145.0" y="231.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">S / √n</text>
<text x="145" y="290" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">normal spread</text>
<text x="145" y="314" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">of the readings</text>
<rect x="290" y="58" width="490" height="300" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="535" y="90" font-size="22" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type B</text>
<text x="535" y="116" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">certificates, specs, prior knowledge</text>
<rect x="305" y="136" width="145" height="96" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="377.5" y="166.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub1</text>
<text x="377.5" y="189.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">certificate</text>
<text x="377.5" y="212.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">U / k</text>
<rect x="462" y="136" width="145" height="96" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="534.5" y="166.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub2</text>
<text x="534.5" y="189.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">accuracy</text>
<text x="534.5" y="212.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">value / √3</text>
<rect x="619" y="136" width="145" height="96" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="691.5" y="166.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub3</text>
<text x="691.5" y="189.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">resolution</text>
<text x="691.5" y="212.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">(res / 2) / √3</text>
<rect x="383" y="246" width="145" height="96" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="455.5" y="276.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub4</text>
<text x="455.5" y="299.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">hysteresis</text>
<text x="455.5" y="322.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">diff / √3</text>
<rect x="540" y="246" width="145" height="96" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="612.5" y="276.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub5</text>
<text x="612.5" y="299.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">zero error</text>
<text x="612.5" y="322.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">zero / √3</text>
<polyline points="145,358 145,390 400,390 400,404" fill="none" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="535,358 535,390 400,390" fill="none" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="170" y="406" width="460" height="62" rx="10" fill="#b45309" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="443.65" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">uc = √(Ua² + Ub1² + ... + Ub5²)</text>
<line x1="400" y1="468" x2="400" y2="486" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="170" y="488" width="460" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="522.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">U = k × uc, k = 2 for about 95%</text>
</svg>

figs.name: measurement-uncertainty-in-calibration-4-bar-flowchart
figs.alt: step by step uncertainty calculation flowchart at 4 bar from Ua to expanded uncertainty
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working the 4 bar point: Ua 0.001, Ub1 0.005, Ub2 0.002309, Ub3 0.000289, Ub4 0.001155 give uc 0.00572 bar and U 0.011 bar.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Step by step uncertainty calculation at the 4 bar point of a 0 to 10 bar gauge</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Uncertainty at the 4 Bar Point, Step by Step</text>
<rect x="40" y="66" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="99.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Readings</text>
<text x="205.0" y="123.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">up 4.006, down 4.004 bar</text>
<line x1="205" y1="144" x2="205" y2="164" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="166" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="199.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ua repeatability</text>
<text x="205.0" y="223.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.001414 / √2 = 0.001</text>
<line x1="205" y1="244" x2="205" y2="264" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="266" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="299.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub1 certificate</text>
<text x="205.0" y="323.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.01 / 2 = 0.005</text>
<line x1="205" y1="344" x2="205" y2="364" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="366" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="399.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub2 accuracy</text>
<text x="205.0" y="423.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.004 / √3 = 0.002309</text>
<rect x="420" y="66" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="99.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub3 resolution</text>
<text x="585.0" y="123.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.0005 / √3 = 0.000289</text>
<line x1="585" y1="144" x2="585" y2="164" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="420" y="166" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="199.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub4 hysteresis</text>
<text x="585.0" y="223.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.002 / √3 = 0.001155</text>
<line x1="585" y1="244" x2="585" y2="264" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="420" y="266" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="299.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Ub5 zero error</text>
<text x="585.0" y="323.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 / √3 = 0</text>
<line x1="585" y1="344" x2="585" y2="364" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="420" y="366" width="330" height="78" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="585.0" y="399.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Combined uc</text>
<text x="585.0" y="423.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RSS = 0.00572 bar</text>
<polyline points="205,444 205,458 385,458 385,52 585,52 585,64" fill="none" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="585" y1="444" x2="585" y2="480" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="380" y="484" width="400" height="96" rx="10" fill="#b45309" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="580.0" y="514.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Expanded U = 2 × 0.00572</text>
<text x="580.0" y="538.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 0.011 bar at k = 2</text>
<text x="580.0" y="562.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">about 95% confidence</text>
<rect x="40" y="484" width="320" height="96" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200.0" y="514.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">All values in bar</text>
<text x="200.0" y="537.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reference: 0 to 40 bar,</text>
<text x="200.0" y="560.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.1% of reading</text>
</svg>
